headline: Contract amendments, a stairway contract cancellation, Veterans Pool construction, police drones, and Flock Safety renewal.
summary: The agenda lists contract amendments, equipment purchases, and emergency snow equipment contracts for city departments. It also includes a notice of cancellation for the Tidewater Stairway Construction contract and an approval to advertise an RFP for the Veterans Pool.

Freight Street Phase 1 FFE procurement with WB Mason

Veterans Pool Construction Phase approval to advertise RFP
Two Ford F250 vehicles, cooperative purchase with CMG
Unmanned aerial drone informal bid 1 from US Drones Supply
Unmanned aerial drone informal bid 2 from Drone Nerds
